_comment: STILL image generation (profile headshots, classroom stills).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: tall, upright and poised, shoulders back, deliberate movement

face: oval face with strong cheekbones, level dark brown eyes with a steady gaze, full mouth held in composed neutral, flawless deep-brown skin with warm undertone, defined brows
hair: long box braids gathered into a high crown-like updo, a few braids framing the face; immaculate hairline

wardrobe.teaching: crisp white lab coat worn open over an emerald or royal-blue tailored blouse and dark fitted trousers; coat cuffs turned back once
alternates: emerald blazer without the lab coat for headshots
safety glasses pushed up on the head during demonstrations

accessories: NSC data sheet on a clipboard

presence.posture: stands tall and centred, one hand resting on the bench; turns from the waist to address the board, never hurried
presence.default_expression: calm authority with a flicker of pride when a result lands; brief, deliberate smile
presence.energy: regal precision - commands attention by being exact
presence.spoken_register: formal, confident and measured, regal flourish on key results

environment: clean science laboratory, gas taps and glassware in soft focus, a balanced equation written cleanly on the board
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 36-42 year old Black South African female teacher. oval face with strong cheekbones, level dark brown eyes with a steady gaze, full mouth held in composed neutral, flawless deep-brown skin with warm undertone, defined brows. Hair: long box braids gathered into a high crown-like updo, a few braids framing the face; immaculate hairline. Wearing crisp white lab coat worn open over an emerald or royal-blue tailored blouse and dark fitted trousers; coat cuffs turned back once. gold geometric statement earrings. Expression: calm authority with a flicker of pride when a result lands; brief, deliberate smile. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, grey seamless or softly blurred classroom background. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.
prompts.classroom: A 36-42 year old Black South African female teacher mid-lesson in a South African school. tall, upright and poised, shoulders back, deliberate movement. oval face with strong cheekbones, level dark brown eyes with a steady gaze, full mouth held in composed neutral, flawless deep-brown skin with warm undertone, defined brows. Hair: long box braids gathered into a high crown-like updo, a few braids framing the face; immaculate hairline. Wearing crisp white lab coat worn open over an emerald or royal-blue tailored blouse and dark fitted trousers; coat cuffs turned back once. Holding/using: gold geometric statement earrings, slim gold bangle. Posture: stands tall and centred, one hand resting on the bench; turns from the waist to address the board, never hurried. Expression: calm authority with a flicker of pride when a result lands; brief, deliberate smile. Setting: clean science laboratory, gas taps and glassware in soft focus, a balanced equation written cleanly on the board. BOARD: the board is mostly wiped clean and shows one short correct formula, for example  v = u + at - nothing else written anywhere on it, no dense columns of equations, no filler handwriting; the board sits behind the focal plane and is slightly soft. practical daylight from classroom windows plus soft fill; avoid flat overhead fluorescent. full-frame, 35mm f/2.8 for context or 50mm f/2 for waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, American classroom props, chalkboard gibberish, unreadable equations, board crowded with writing, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph
